CABIN_MAP = {'first': 'business', 'premium_economy': 'business'}

    # Fix NULL departure/arrival times
    new_dep = dep if dep else "06:00:00"
    new_arr = arr if arr else "08:00:00"
    if new_dep != dep or new_arr != arr:
        cursor.execute("UPDATE flights SET departure_time=?, arrival_time=? WHERE flight_id=?",
                       (new_dep, new_arr, fid))

                date_val['status'] = 'available'
                if 'available_seats' not in date_val:
                    date_val['available_seats'] = {'economy': 50, 'business': 10, 'basic_economy': 30}
                if 'prices' not in date_val:
                    date_val['prices'] = {'economy': 200, 'business': 500, 'basic_economy': 100}
                dates_changed = True

                        new_prices[k] = v
                    elif k in CABIN_MAP:

                for k, v in date_val['available_seats'].items():
